title: InstallationPlan step-kind registry
description: Format of registry/plan-step-kinds.json: the CLOSED vocabulary of InstallationPlan step kinds (CF12, CF13; docs/installation-plan.md). A plan step whose kind is not listed here is rejected (UNKNOWN_STEP_KIND). For each kind: the platforms and whether it is privileged there; the Windows elevated-helper operation; a required separate acknowledgement; whether a licence is required; which optional step members it requires or allows; the allowed values of the three flags; the official source URL prefixes (a guard rail; the pinned sha256 is the trust anchor); the execution preconditions; the fixed command templates per platform; and the title templates.

placeholders.description: The only placeholders allowed in command templates.

preconditions.description: Execution preconditions checked right before a step runs, against freshly observed facts (`reads`) and the consented plan step. A failing precondition stops the step with the reason code; the bootstrap operation moves from INSTALLING per on_reject.

privileged.description: true: the step runs with host elevation (Windows: UAC through the elevated helper; Linux: sudo for the fixed commands of this kind). Root inside the Sprut WSL distribution is not host elevation.

flag_rule.description: never: the flag is false; always: the flag is true; may: the planner decides from the probe.

command.description: One operation. argv: a program started with this exact argument list (no shell); argv[0] is absolute: `{system32}\\...` for a Windows program, or a Linux path (on Windows it runs inside the Sprut distribution as root through `{system32}\\wsl.exe --distribution {distro_name} --user root --exec`; on Linux privileged kinds run it through `/usr/bin/sudo --`). install_file: the core writes `content` to a file it owns and installs it at `path` with `mode` (`/usr/bin/install -D -m <mode>`, as root like argv). client_action: a fixed core operation (download_source: download step.source over HTTPS into a staging directory of the client; verify_source: run by the same principal as the step's commands (root through sudo or in the distribution, or the elevated helper), copy the download into a directory only that principal can write (Linux: `install -m 0600 -o root -g root`; Windows helper: an Administrators-only directory), compute the SHA-256 of that copy and compare it with step.source.sha256 (INTEGRITY_MISMATCH otherwise); `{verified_file}` is that copy; edit_wslconfig: the managed-key edit of docs/wsl-resources.md; engine_pull: engine API pull of step.image). when: only if step.source is present / absent.

windows_elevated_step.description: Operation of the Windows elevated (UAC) helper; present exactly for kinds privileged on windows; equals the kind in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (Java ElevatedStep).

acknowledgement.description: A separate explicit acknowledgement the user must give, beyond plan consent and --yes (guard input given_acknowledgements; CLI --accept-docker-group / --accept-distro-removal; GUI control unchecked by default).

licence_required.description: A step of this kind must list at least one licence in licence_ids.

source_url_prefixes.description: Official sources (a guard rail; the pinned sha256 is the trust anchor): the parsed final URL of a download must start with one of these prefixes. Each prefix is https://, a host and a path ending with `/`. Non-empty exactly when the kind requires or allows `source`.

environment.description: Environment variables the executor sets for this kind's commands, on top of its fixed base environment (never inherited from the user). Only DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive is allowed.

commands.description: Fixed command templates per platform of the kind, executed in order. Nothing from the host, the user or the network becomes part of a command except the placeholders.

title.description: Title template. The only placeholder is {repository} (the repository part of the step's image), allowed only for kinds that require image. A step's title must equal the rendered template exactly.

title_without_source.description: Title used when an optional source is absent (the download is done by another program and not verified by Sprut). Present exactly for kinds with an optional source.
